writeup: TIC 65257021 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 4.7906 days. Observations from TESS photometry reveal a primary eclipse with a depth of 4.35% dimming, along with a secondary eclipse detected at 5.7 sigma significance near orbital phase 0.49. The binary light curve shows a strong automated detection signal with a Box Least Squares value of 118.7. Pixel-level image analysis provides supporting evidence, with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise ratio of 6.1, though the centroid offset of 2.2 arcseconds from the target coordinates warrants note. This candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously uncatalogued object. The pipeline's machine learning classifier assigned it a score of 0.41 on a scale where higher values indicate greater likelihood of being a genuine target.
